name: Ambla SK SV suusatajate seeriajooks+kepikõnd
description: Ambla SK SV Skiers’ Series Run + Nordic Walking is a multi-stage running and Nordic walking series held at Kangrumägi in Järva County. The competition consists of five stages: the first four are time trials, and the final stage is a mass-start run. The results of the best four stages count toward the series standings, and prizes are awarded by age group. The competition is intended for runners using ski poles, which can be borrowed if needed. Special prizes are awarded to those who complete the series.
course_highlights: Five stages: the first four are time trials, and the final stage is a mass-start run
Held at Kangrumägi in Järva County
Only runners using ski poles are included in the competition standings
additional: Only runners using ski poles are included in the competition standings. Ski poles can be borrowed if needed. Every runner or Nordic walker who completes all five stages receives a special prize. Age groups range from age 6 to 55+. Points are awarded as follows: 1st place 30 points, 2nd place 27 points, 3rd place 25 points, and so on. In the event of a tie, the placing in the final stage decides. The fifth stage is scheduled for 8 November 2026, starting at 12:00. The best four stage results count toward the series standings.

name: 53. Saaremaa kolme päeva jooks
description: The Saaremaa Three-Day Run is a traditional running competition in Kuressaare, inviting all running enthusiasts to take part. The event offers several distance options and age groups, with opportunities for both young people and adults. Registration takes place on site, and the entry fee is affordable, making the event accessible to a wide range of participants. The competition is part of a larger running series, which also includes season standings and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Several distances and age groups
The competition takes place in Kuressaare and the surrounding area
Electronic timing and event organization are provided for participants
additional: Registration takes place on site; participants are advised to arrive at least 15 minutes before the start. Electronic timing uses chips attached to the back of reusable race bibs. Race bibs and drinking cups are reusable and should be returned after the run. At the end of the competition, all participants receive a diploma and a sweet treat. You can register individually, as a pair, or as a team. Information about accommodation, transport, and catering is available on the organizer’s website.

name: Saaremaa Kolme Päeva Jooks
description: Saaremaa Three-Day Run is a traditional running competition held in the village of Iide. The competition consists of three stages, where participants can enjoy Saaremaa’s beautiful nature and varied terrain. The event is open to different age groups and offers a friendly, supportive atmosphere for everyone who enjoys running. Participants are provided with electronic timing, reusable bibs and drinking cups, and a sweet snack and drink after the run.
course_highlights: A three-day running competition in Saaremaa’s picturesque countryside
Reusable bibs with timing chips
A sweet snack and refreshment stations at the finish
additional: Timing is recorded using chips attached to the back of the bib, which must be returned after the competition. The entry fee covers event organisation, electronic timing, a drink, candy and a diploma at the finish. Reusable drinking cups and bibs help reduce waste. All participants receive a diploma after the run, and prizes are awarded to the three fastest runners in each age group. The competition includes individual and team classifications. Information about accommodation, transport and catering is available on the organiser’s website.

name: Krusensterni jooks
location: Purila bus stop, Purila, Rapla County, Estonia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Õpilastele, pensionäridele ja Purila ning Hagudi elanikele - 4€

description: The Krusenstern Run is a traditional running race starting at the Purila bus stop and finishing at Hagudi Manor. The race is 4.2 km long and is suitable for students, pensioners and adults. The top men and women are awarded prizes, and special prizes are given to athletes in the veteran category, the youngest and oldest finishers, and the largest family. Participation is at your own risk, and all finishers are offered water, a treat and hot tea.
course_highlights: A 4.2 km route from the Purila bus stop to Hagudi Manor
The route is suitable for runners and Nordic walkers
Water, a treat and hot tea await participants at the finish
additional: Registration takes place at the Purila bus stop from 12:00 to 12:30 and online. The entry fee must be paid to the MTÜ Rapla Jooksuklubi Swedbank account. The awards ceremony takes place at 14:00. Prizes are awarded to the three top men and women and the top veterans. On-site registration is available at the Purila bus stop from 12:00 to 12:30 or online. The entry fee is €4 for students, pensioners, and residents of Purila and Hagudi, and €8 for adults. All finishers receive water, a treat and hot tea; the awards ceremony begins at 14:00.

name: Emili jookseb
description: Emili Runs is a cheerful school community running event held in Kadriorg Park in autumn, attended by students, teachers and parents alike. The focus is on the joy of movement and supporting one another, not speed. This traditional event fosters a sense of togetherness and gives the community enjoyable moments of outdoor exercise. The first run took place amid golden leaves and was an inspiring start to the school holidays.
course_highlights: Colourful autumn scenery in Kadriorg Park
Fresh air and golden leaves
A cheerful, supportive atmosphere
additional: The whole school community took part, including parents, highlighting the community’s sense of togetherness. The aim of the run is to enjoy being active and encourage one another, not to compete for speed. The tradition continues with the spring event “Emili Rolls!” The event brings together students, teachers and parents and celebrates the joy of movement and encouraging one another.

name: 3. Holstre-Polli ööjooks
location: Holstre-Polli Sports Centre, Holstre, Viljandi County, Estonia
description: The 3rd Holstre-Polli Night Run takes place on the health and ski trails of Holstre-Polli Sports Centre in Viljandi County. This night run gives participants the chance to experience the wilderness and tranquillity surrounding the sports centre. The event is part of Holstre-Polli Sports Centre’s sports events series and is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational participants. Participants can enjoy a unique night-running experience amid beautiful nature.
course_highlights: Run on the health and ski trails of Holstre-Polli Sports Centre
A night-running experience in the wilderness
15 km from Viljandi, in a peaceful and calming setting
additional: A headlamp is compulsory for all participants. Participant numbers are limited: 70 places in the children’s run and 140 places in total for the main run and Nordic walking. On-site registration is available if places remain.

name: Pärnu Rannajooks
description: Pärnu Beach Run is the season-ending race and final event in the Pärnu Two Bridges Club’s three-event series. It takes place at Pärnu Beach Stadium. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances, which can be completed by running or walking with or without Nordic walking poles. The course runs through the beautiful Pärnu beach area, offering natural scenery and architectural landmarks characteristic of the city, including the seaside promenade. The event is suitable for recreational and experienced runners alike and offers an enjoyable sporting experience.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances, available for running or walking with or without Nordic walking poles
Course through Pärnu’s beach area, with beautiful natural scenery and architectural landmarks
Seaside promenade with views of the sea
additional: The distance options are 5 km and 10 km, which can be completed by running or walking with or without Nordic walking poles. The race is part of the Pärnu Two Bridges Club’s three-event series. Children’s races and virtual race distances are also planned. The event includes virtual races and children’s races and takes place at Pärnu Beach Stadium, offering a chance to enjoy sport and nature together.

name: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+
description: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+ is a trail race among the beautiful hiking trails and forests of Vooremäe in Tartu County. The race highlights challenges such as 1,000 metres of elevation gain in a single run, giving participants the chance to test their abilities and enjoy the positive energy of running on forest trails. The race centre is next to the new service building, with convenient shower facilities and a place to change clothes. There is a staffed aid station on the course, and timing uses a contactless SPORTIdent system. Distances range from a 14 km hike to a marathon of over 42 km, with marathon runners completing exactly three 14.1 km laps.
course_highlights: A 14.1 km lap following the direction of travel on Vooremäe’s large loop
More than 1,000 metres of total elevation gain on the marathon distance
A staffed aid station on the course, passed multiple times
additional: Race numbers can be found before the event in the start list on the Seiklushunt website. Timing uses the contactless SPORTIdent (SI AIR) system, with the chip attached to the wrist. Participants can shower and change clothes at the race centre after the event. There is one staffed aid station on the course, offering water, Coca-Cola and light snacks. On-site registration is not available. Transfers and other changes can be made only by email. Trail running, hilly terrain, registration via Stebby, aid stations, finisher medals, awards ceremony

name: 2026 Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev
location: Rocca al Mare kool, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev is a traditional winter running event taking place on 19 December 2026 in front of Rocca al Mare School in Tallinn. The event centre and start/finish are conveniently located at the school, and the programme includes three distances: a marathon, a relay marathon and an 8.4 km run. The courses run mainly along shared-use paths and are well marked and safe, offering a sporting way to end the year. Participants are provided with medical assistance, timing, medals, and hot tea at the refreshment stations and finish.
course_highlights: The 8.4 km run follows shared-use paths and is marked with signs and course marshals.
The marathon consists of 5 laps, each a 8.44 km paved shared-use path.
The relay marathon consists of 5 legs, each a lap of 8.44 km.
additional: The marathon and relay marathon have participant limits of 100 marathon runners and 150 teams, respectively. The 8.4 km run is limited to 150 runners. Race numbers are distributed on race day at Rocca al Mare School. Medical assistance is available at the start/finish area. Awards are presented after the run or marathon, as applicable. Running on the road is prohibited and may result in disqualification. The course is in an urban setting. Registration and entry fees are listed in detail. The event is held annually and is part of the Estonian running calendar.

name: ÜLEMISTE Grit 2027
organizer: Eesti Ööjooks - Night Run Estonia ja Liikumisharrastuse kompetentsikeskus

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Virtuaalne osalemine: 24€ (sisaldab medalit, tulemuse haldamise tasu ja saatmiskulu)

description: Ülemiste Grit is an immersive endurance running event held inside Ülemiste Centre in Tallinn. Participants can choose a 1-, 2- or 3-hour challenge, running a 552-metre loop. The event is not a race, but an opportunity to enjoy moving and challenge yourself: you can run, walk or power-walk. There is an aid station on the course offering water, juice and solid food, and a medal and gift bag await at the finish. The event has a limited number of participants and offers a unique indoor running experience.
course_highlights: The course runs on the second floor of Ülemiste Centre; each loop is 552 m long.
The indoor course has tiled floors and extensive glass surfaces, so take care.
The aid station offers water, juice, Coca-Cola and solid food (banana, pickles, bread, meat product, chocolate and orange).
additional: Race pack collection takes place from 19:00 to 21:30 on the third floor of the Ülemiste Centre parking garage. Bag storage at the event centre costs €2. Medals and gift bags are handed out at the event centre after finishing. After finishing, participants are asked to stay in the finish area briefly for a group photo. Participants in the 2-hour distance are asked to enter the start area via the first floor (take the escalator near Rimi). The event is sold out; on-site registration is not available. The virtual run option ends on 22.04.2027. Participants can leave their own drinks bottles along the course, labelled with their names. The event is non-competitive and emphasises cooperation and safety. Participants receive gift bags; the course is designed to be an experience, not for chasing records.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Kevadjooks 2027
location: Sportland Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Kõrvemaa, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Spring Run is a beautiful spring running event held amid the ancient natural landscapes of the Kõrvemaa Nature Reserve. The event centre is conveniently located near Tallinn at the Sportland Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre. The varied routes include a 16 km main distance, a 6 km run and a youth run. Free children’s runs, activities for the whole family and childcare are also available. After the run, participants can enjoy hot soup, a sauna and hot tubs, as well as an exciting treasure hunt at Anija Manor.
course_highlights: The entire route runs through a nature reserve
A range of distances: 16 km, 6 km and a youth run
Event centre conveniently located near Tallinn
additional: Free bus transport is provided for participants between Aegviidu railway station and the event centre, in both directions. The event centre has childcare, a bag drop, a Stebby wellbeing area with Fysiotikker, and a Sportland pop-up shop where you can top up on running gear. For children, Aegviidu RMK offers nature-themed activities, a low ropes course, a mini-pancake café, and horse and pony rides (bring cash). A sauna and hot tubs will be open after the run. Participants can enter a draw to win a stylish Trek city bike at the Spring Run awards ceremony at 14:00. Group discounts: 10% off when registering at least 5 participants, and 20% off when registering at least 10 participants. A 50% discount is available for seniors (60+) and young people (up to 17) when registering in advance; the minimum final price is €15. The event takes place on 25 April 2027, offering a choice of distances and the chance to enjoy outdoor exercise and time with family.

name: 45. Tartu Maastikumaraton
description: The 45th Tartu Forest Marathon is a traditional event held at the Tartumaa Sports Centre, offering participants the chance to enjoy trail running in beautiful natural surroundings. The event is part of Estonia’s programme to promote recreational physical activity and is suitable for runners of different abilities who want to improve their fitness and mental well-being. The marathon highlights the importance of physical activity for maintaining health and well-being and invites everyone who leads an active lifestyle to take part. It is organised by the Centre of Excellence for Physical Activity, which supports the development of a healthier and more active society in Estonia.
course_highlights: Trail running through the beautiful forest landscapes of the Tartumaa Sports Centre
A varied and changing course suitable for runners of different abilities
An opportunity to enjoy nature and improve mental and physical health
additional: The event takes place at the Tartumaa Sports Centre. Participants can register and collect their race numbers at Turu 10 in Tartu and in the car park at Aura Centre.

name: 3. Benno Viirandi nimeline rahvajooks
location: Tarvastu Gümnaasiumi staadion, Tarvastu, Viljandi County, Estonia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Osavõtumaks on nii jooksjatele kui ka kepikõndijatele (alates sünniaastast 2009 ja varem sündinud) eelregistreerimisel 10.- eurot

description: The 3rd Benno Viirand Memorial Fun Run is a family-friendly running and Nordic walking event held in the small town of Mustla. The race takes place on a 5 km course that starts near the Vambola bus stop in Soe village and finishes at the Tarvastu Gymnasium stadium. The event aims to honor the memory of legendary runner Benno Viirand and promote running as a healthy way to spend leisure time. In addition to the main race, free children’s races take place at the stadium. Participants are provided with race numbers and can register in advance or at the venue on race day.
course_highlights: 5 km course from the Vambola bus stop in Soe village to the Tarvastu Gymnasium stadium
Nordic walkers can also take part in the main distance
Children’s races take place at the stadium after the main race starts
additional: Bus transport to the start is provided from Tarvastu Gymnasium stadium at 17:50; if needed, the bus will make two trips. Race-day registration at the start venue is open from 17:30 to 18:15. Participation in the children’s races is free. Competitors can collect their race numbers before the start on race day. The participation fee must be paid to the bank account. Registration is open until 27.05.2026. Safety and responsibility are the participants’ own responsibility.

name: Arco Vara 55. jooks ümber Harku järve

price_tiers.distance: Arco Vara 55. jooks ümber Harku järve

description: The 55th Arco Vara Run Around Lake Harku is a traditional 6.5 km running race taking place on 30 May 2026 at Lake Harku Beach. The race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is its second event. There are refreshment points along the course, which is marked and secured by course marshals. Nordic walkers and walkers are also welcome; they start in the last group. The event center is at the start-finish area, where race numbers are also distributed and the awards ceremony takes place.
course_highlights: A 6.5 km loop around Lake Harku
Refreshment points at the 3 km mark and at the finish
Course marshals and a marked route
additional: Race numbers will be distributed on race day from 9:30 to 11:30 at Lake Harku Beach. Timing is chip-based, with the chip attached to the back of the race number. Participants receive a medal, sports drink and water on the course and at the finish, as well as medical assistance throughout the course. The awards ceremony is scheduled for approximately 13:00, with awards for the top 6 men and women and the age-group winners. The event has two distances and children's races; registration opens at 9:30 and the start is at 12:00. Participants can enjoy nature and a healthy lifestyle.

name: Koeru kergejõustikuvõistlused
location: Koeru KK staadion, Koeru, Järva County, Estonia
description: The Koeru athletics competition is a traditional track and field event held at the Koeru KK stadium. Men and women compete in two age groups across several events, including the 100 m, long jump, shot put, discus throw, javelin throw and 1000 m. The winner is determined by adding the points from their three best events. The competition is open to everyone, who may take part in all events. Young athletes use throwing implements appropriate for their age group.
course_highlights: Events: 100 m, long jump, shot put, discus throw, javelin throw and 1000 m
There are 4 attempts in the long jump and throwing events
The competition takes place at Koeru KK stadium
additional: In the men’s and women’s competitions, the winner of the three-event competition is awarded a cup, and places 2–6 receive medals. Winners of individual events are awarded medals. Young athletes use throwing implements appropriate for their age group. The competition takes place on 30 May 2026 at the Koeru sports track. Participants can score points across several events, and winners are awarded cups and medals.

name: Maardu kevadjooks
description: The Maardu Spring Run and Health Walk is a traditional sports day held in Maardu, bringing together people of all ages who enjoy being active. The event features several runs and health walks for different age groups and abilities, including children’s races, a youth run, a walk for people with special needs, and 3 km and 5 km runs. Participation is free, and every finisher receives a medal. The event aims to offer the joy of movement, a sense of well-being, and an active day in the fresh air, while celebrating time spent together with family and friends.
course_highlights: Several distances: 100 m children’s race, 1 km youth run, 500 m walk for people with special needs, and 3 km and 5 km runs
Health walk over a 3 km distance
Starts and activities take place on the main avenue beside the Maxima XX shopping centre
additional: Participation is free. Registration is open online until 29 May at 19:00, or at Maardu City Stadium from 14 to 29 May, 13:00–17:00. On the day of the Spring Run, on-site registration is available only for the 500 m walk for people with special needs. All finishers receive a medal. The day concludes with a lottery among participants. Registration and the award ceremony take place at the finish on race day. The event includes various running and walking distances and is intended for the whole family.

name: jooks ümber Harku järve

price_tiers.distance: Arco Vara 55. jooks ümber Harku järve 6,5 km

description: The 55th Arco Vara Run Around Lake Harku takes place on May 30, 2026, at Lake Harku beach in Tallinn. This 6.5 km race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is the series’ second event. Nordic walkers and walkers are also welcome and will start in the last group. There are water stations along the course, and the event center also offers a children’s athletics workshop and pop-up shops. Participants receive a medal, chip timing, sports drink and water on the course, and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: A 6.5 km loop around Lake Harku
Water stations at the 3 km mark and at the finish
Course marshals and a marked route
additional: Race numbers will be issued on event day from 9:30 to 11:30 at Lake Harku beach. Timing is provided by a chip attached to the back of the race number. Participants are provided with a medal, sports drink and water on the course and at the finish, as well as medical assistance. The awards ceremony is at 13:00. Nordic walkers start after the runners, in the last starting group. Event-day activities include children’s races, an awards ceremony, prize draws, and additional activities such as a ski jump hill and sports equipment sales. Registration is open until 2026-05-20.

name: Läänemaa sörgib ühissörk
description: Läänemaa Sör gib ühissörk (Läänemaa Community Jog) is a cheerful, relaxed family event taking place on May 31 at Haapsalu railway station. The community jog covers approximately 3+ kilometres at an easy running pace (~7:30 min/km) and welcomes everyone in Läänemaa who enjoys being active. The event is the grand finale of a campaign that brings together the various jogs held across the county during May. Both previous participants and newcomers are welcome to enjoy being active together and strengthen the sense of community.
course_highlights: Start at Haapsalu railway station
Easy pace of about 7:30 min/km
Distance of approximately 3+ km
additional: The community jog is part of a wider activity campaign taking place in different parts of Läänemaa during May. The event welcomes everyone who enjoys being active, offering a chance to enjoy movement together and strengthen the sense of community. The relaxed pace makes it well suited to families. Young people and adults take part, highlighting a healthy lifestyle and community involvement. Detailed registration and participation conditions have not been publicly announced.

name: Meie oma maijooks 2026
description: Our own Maijooks 2026 is a traditional running event taking place on 1 June at the Kolga-Jaani School stadium and sports fields. The event offers different distances and age groups suitable for runners, Nordic walkers and recreational exercisers of all ages. Its aim is to promote a healthy lifestyle, offer an opportunity to compete, and celebrate family-friendly activities in the Kolga-Jaani area. Participants can enjoy a pleasant evening run on the light-traffic road and at the stadium, with recognition for the best runners and representatives of the area.
course_highlights: Children’s races on the stadium track for children up to 7 years old
1.5 km youth race on the light-traffic road
4.5 km main race starting from Kolga-Jaani Stadium and running through the surrounding area
additional: The event includes children’s races for those up to 7 years old, with no results recorded, a 1.5 km youth race and a 4.5 km main race. Nordic walkers may take part in the main race. Entry fees are paid and race numbers collected at the registration tent on race day. Prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in the youth and main races, as well as to the best local participants with a special award. The races take place at the stadium and sports fields; registration is required; free for children born after 2010.

name: Virtuaaljooks suvi 2026
description: Virtual Run Summer 2026 is a flexible remote running competition that allows participants to complete their chosen distance in their local area at a time that suits them. The event offers several distance options, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21 km), as well as a children’s run. Participants can record and upload their results to the GoAndRun.eu portal, ensuring reliable results and comparison with participants around the world. Virtual Run offers a convenient, environmentally friendly way to take part in a sporting event without having to travel to the venue.
course_highlights: A virtual running competition that can be completed in your local area
Distances available: 5 km, 10 km and a 21 km half marathon
Record and upload results from sports watch and app files
additional: Participants can upload results from files generated by popular sports watches and apps (.fit, .gpx, .tcx, .pwx), or enter their results manually. The competition supports fair-play rules and allows results to be made public anonymously or kept private. Virtual Run makes taking part in sporting events accessible to everyone, even when unexpected obstacles arise. Registration and participation take place online. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and supports Estonian veterans through charity.

name: Kambja Tervisejooksud
description: Kambja Health Runs is a traditional event in a running series that began in 2016 and will take place in three stages in 2026. The runs are held on the Kambja health trails, giving participants the chance to enjoy forest paths and some asphalt sections. The series aims to promote healthy lifestyles and motivate people to take up recreational running. Each stage includes a 10 km competitive race, as well as a health run and a power run, where body weight and elevation gain are used in the calculations. Runners who take part in all three stages receive a series T-shirt, and the grand prize winners receive a Merida Big Nine 20 bicycle.
course_highlights: The runs take place on the Kambja health trails, mainly on forest paths
The 10 km competitive race consists of one or two 5 km laps
The power run uses a formula based on body weight and elevation gain to determine the winner
additional: The start is open from 18:00 to 20:00 on the event day. The 10 km competitive race starts at 18:00 at each stage, and the finish closes at 21:00. Timing is electronic. Registration is free and available online at regama.ee/kambja or on site at the event centre. The top three in the competitive race receive medals or trophies. Three stages, registration online or on site, part of the Tartumaa Running and Walking Series

name: 5. ETAPP - Merimets
location: Pelguranna and Stroomi beach parking lots, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Stage 5 - Merimetsa is part of the 24th Health Run and Walk series, held in the Pelguranna and Stroomi Beach car parks. This 3.6 km stage gives participants the opportunity to enjoy beautiful nature and fitness trails in a coastal area. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers who want to spend time actively and improve their health. The series stages take place in different areas of Tallinn, offering varied landscapes and views.
course_highlights: A 3.6 km route in the Merimetsa area
Near the Pelguranna and Stroomi Beach car parks
Coastal scenery and beautiful natural surroundings
additional: The event is part of a broader health and fitness series featuring various running and walking events, aimed at health-conscious participants across Estonia.

name: Filter Temposari
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia’s oldest and most prestigious time-trial series, offering the chance to test yourself in cycling, running or inline skating. The series’ six stages take place around Tallinn and feature timed races with staggered starts, allowing participants to measure their fitness precisely. The series also includes a paired start at the Kiili stage and the Kullapada rewards programme, which recognises consistent participation. Races are generally held on Wednesday evenings, and the courses are fast and short, making them well suited to sprint enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Individual time trials in cycling; paired starts are permitted at the Kiili stage
Fast, short sprints in running (3–6 km) and inline skating
Courses on roads around Tallinn, partly open to traffic; safety is important
additional: Hot Group: the final 10 minutes of the stage are reserved for the top cyclists. Warming up on the course during the race is prohibited; warm-up trainers are available free of charge at the race centre. Traffic is controlled on the race courses, but most of the route is not closed to cars. Participants must follow traffic laws and keep to the right-hand side of the road. The series’ Kullapada rewards programme recognises consistent participation at every stage. Several stages and participant categories, prizes and medals, the detailed schedule and registration are available on the website. The event takes place on Wednesday evenings and offers various distance options.

name: Valgamaa lahtised MV
description: The Valgamaa Open Championships in Orienteering Sprint is an orienteering competition held in the Valga area. The event is part of the RMK Eestimaa Orienteering Series, family events with no age restrictions. The courses are designed for participants of different skill levels, and competitors can choose their own pace. Timing is used, and an SI card can be rented if needed to help with orienteering. The event is for everyone who wants to enjoy outdoor activity and orienteering in good company.
course_highlights: Orienteering sprint in the Valga area
Courses suitable for participants of different skill levels
SI card available to rent; compass can also be used
additional: The competition is part of the RMK Eestimaa Orienteering Series, family events with no age restrictions. Competitors are advised to wear sports clothing and bring a compass and an SI card, which can also be rented if needed. Timing is used, but competing is not compulsory; the emphasis is on enjoying outdoor activity and choosing a comfortable pace. Participants can take part in different distances and enjoy Estonian nature and sport. The competitions are open to different age groups and offer a variety of sporting experiences.

name: Lammasmäe Eesti Ööjooks - Rakvere 2026
description: LAMMASMÄE Estonian Night Run - Rakvere 2026 is a night running race taking place in Rakvere on June 12, 2026. This popular sporting event brings together running enthusiasts and offers an exciting, lively night-running experience. The race takes place amid the beautiful scenery around Rakvere, giving participants a unique opportunity to enjoy sport and the urban environment at night.
course_highlights: Night run in Rakvere and its surroundings
Beautiful and varied terrain
Lively and energetic race atmosphere
additional: The event includes a range of distance options and promotes healthy lifestyles and community support.

name: Narva Linna Jooks
description: Narva City Run is Ida-Virumaa’s largest sporting event. It encourages people to take up physical activity and showcases the region on Estonia’s cultural and sporting scene. The beautiful route through the border city, with its rich history, attracts participants from Narva, elsewhere in Virumaa, across Estonia and abroad. The event takes place by the Joaoru beach building and recreation area, offering a varied and engaging running experience.
course_highlights: A beautiful route through the border city of Narva
Held as Ida-Virumaa’s largest sporting event
Participants from the local area and abroad
additional: The event takes place on 5 June 2026, starting at 17:30, by the Joaoru beach building and recreation area at Linnuse tn 2, 20308 Narva. The entry fee is 25 euros and covers various distances and the children’s run. The route passes through Narva’s scenic spots, and the event is part of the Ida-Virumaa sports events series.

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
location: Jaanikese Moto- ja Vabaajakeskus, Jaanikese, Tartu County, Estonia
description: The Jaanikese Cross-Country Run is the second event in the running series and takes place at the Jaanikese Moto and Recreation Centre. The course features varied terrain suitable for both recreational and experienced runners. The event offers the chance to enjoy a sporting competition in beautiful natural surroundings and is part of the centre’s active running and cycling trail network.
course_highlights: A varied running course on the grounds of the Jaanikese Moto and Recreation Centre
The route includes a hiking trail, cycling trail and running trail
Scenic views and varied terrain
additional: The cross-country run is part of the running and cycling trail network at the Jaanikese Moto and Recreation Centre, which also has a hiking trail and disc golf facilities. The centre has a history room and a café, open on training days. The event is organised by Valga Sport and is part of a larger set of sporting events where participants can also enjoy activities such as motocross and disc golf.

name: Narva Linna Jooks - 5 km ja 21,1 km
description: The Narva City Run is Ida-Viru County’s largest mass-participation sporting event. It takes place on June 5 and 6 at Joaorg in Narva. The two-day event features a mile race around Town Hall Square on Friday, followed by the main races on Saturday, including the 5 km and 21.1 km distances. This year’s course is flatter, allowing runners to achieve faster times, and the competition also serves as the Estonian Road Mile Championships. The Narva City Run brings thousands of recreational runners and elite athletes to the course, offering a great mass-participation sporting experience.
course_highlights: The flat course allows runners to achieve faster times
The mile race takes place around Town Hall Square on Friday
The main races, over 5 km and 21.1 km, take place on Saturday
additional: The event center is at Town Hall Square. The mile race takes place around the square on Friday, with the start and finish beside the square. The Narva City Run also hosts the Estonian Road Mile Championships. The two-day program features a thoughtfully designed course with sights along the way. More than 3,000 participants are expected. Entry fees were not mentioned.

name: Ida-Virumaa staadioniultra
location: Kohtla-Nõmme Kooli staadion, Kohtla-Nõmme, Ida-Virumaa, Estonia
description: The 5th Kohtla-Nõmme Stadium Ultra, also known as the 6th Ida-Viru County Stadium Ultra, is an ultrarunning event held at Kohtla-Nõmme School Stadium. The race starts at 12:00 on June 6 and continues until midday on June 7, giving participants the opportunity to test their endurance and running ability over an extended period. The event is organized by MTÜ Gurmeejooksud, who welcome all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy the sporting experience.
course_highlights: The race takes place at Kohtla-Nõmme School Stadium
The event lasts 24 hours, from midday on June 6 until midday on June 7
A well-known ultrarunning event in the Ida-Viru County region
additional: The race starts at 12:00 on June 6 and continues until midday on June 7 (24 hours). The event is organized by MTÜ Gurmeejooksud. The race takes place at Kohtla-Nõmme School Stadium, Kooli tn 6, Kohtla-Nõmme, Ida-Viru County. Stadium, ultramarathon, 308 m laps, 12-hour result, Estonian Championships

name: Luhamaa piirijooks
description: Luhamaa Border Run is part of the Võrumaa Running and Walking Series, offering a range of distances for both runners and walkers. The main course is approximately 5.9 km long and runs on asphalt around the Luhamaa village community centre. There are also shorter mini-distances and children’s runs, suitable for participants of all ages. The series aims to offer a sporty and friendly race experience amid Võrumaa’s beautiful scenery.
course_highlights: The main course runs on asphalt around the Luhamaa village community centre
Mini-distances and children’s runs are suitable for beginners and children
The course is mostly paved with asphalt, making it well suited to fast running
additional: The entire course is on asphalt. The children’s runs take place in Kesklinna Park and around EWERS in Väimela. The event is part of the 12-stage Võrumaa Running and Walking Series, which offers various distances and walking options. Information on entry fees and registration; transport arranged; the course partly runs through an area that is not normally accessible to the public.

name: Padise liigub
location: Lääne-Harju Kultuurikeskus Padise rahvamaja, Padise, Lääne-Harju, Estonia
description: Padise liigub is part of the Lääne-Harju movement series and takes place at the Lääne-Harju Cultural Centre Padise Community House. The course runs through Padise’s beautiful countryside, offering excitement and scenic views for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers. The event is suitable for the whole family; alongside the 5 km main distance, children’s races are also scheduled. It’s a wonderful opportunity to enjoy being active in a historic and naturally beautiful setting.
course_highlights: The course runs through Padise’s beautiful countryside
Suitable for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers
Children’s races are held alongside the 5 km main distance
additional: The event centre opens at 10:00; race-number collection and registration take place before the start. Children’s races begin at 11:00, warm-up exercises at 11:45, and the main-distance start is at 12:00. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:50 and the finish closes at 13:15. The route is scenic and suitable for all levels; registration is available on the day of the event from 10:00. The event includes children’s races and a 5 km main distance.

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: The II Jaanikese Cross-Country Run takes place on 6 June 2026 at the Jaanikese Moto and Recreation Centre and is part of the Rein Leppik Memorial Valgamaa Running and Walking Series. The event features several distances, including children’s races, a 2.7 km run and walk, and the 5.4 km main race. The routes follow the cross-country track, giving participants the chance to enjoy a sporting competition across different age groups. The event is organised by the Valgamaa Sports Association, which welcomes everyone interested in running to take part and enjoy an active day.
course_highlights: Races take place on the Jaanikese cross-country track
Several distances, from children’s races to the 5.4 km main race
The course follows a cross-country track, offering varied terrain
additional: Pre-registration is available online at www.timesport.ee. On-site registration opens at 10.30. Electronic timing is provided from the 2019–2020 age group onward. Awards are presented in all age groups, and prizes are awarded to the top three overall finishers in the 5.4 km main race. Children’s races are free of charge. The event takes place on 6 June 2026 and is open to everyone interested in running, offering an opportunity to enjoy nature and take part in recreational sport.

name: SunRun
description: SunRun Saaremaa 2026 is a team running adventure set amid Saaremaa’s beautiful natural scenery. The race starts at sunrise in Kuressaare and finishes at sunset at Illiku laid in Orissaare, covering a total of 180 km. All groups, circles of friends and sports clubs can take part by forming a team and sharing the distance among themselves. The aim is not to win, but to enjoy running together with friends at a comfortable pace. Each participant receives a GPS wristband that serves as a relay baton, and there are refreshment and water stations along the route.
course_highlights: A 180 km route from Kuressaare to Orissaare
15 stages, with the GPS wristband serving as the relay baton
Beautiful running trails and coastline on Saaremaa
additional: The race starts on 6 June at 4:30 in front of the Wow Centre in Kuressaare. Each team receives a GPS wristband, which must be handed to the next runner at points of their choosing. There are water stations along the route, as well as hot soup, tea and bread along the way, and shower facilities at the finish. The finish is at Illiku laid, where a summer starting-party takes place. Changing runners along the route is prohibited. Support vehicles must comply with Estonian traffic regulations. The route includes Saaremaa’s landscapes and coastal roads; registration requires the use of a GPS device and the race kit. The event takes place on 6 June 2026, starting in Kuressaare at 4:30.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 24. Laekvere – Simuna jooks
description: The third stage of the Lääne-Virumaa running and walking series in 2026 is the traditional Simuna-Laekvere Run, which has secured a firm place in runners’ calendars and hearts. The run is unique in that its direction changes every year. The event takes place at Simuna School and invites all running enthusiasts to take part.
course_highlights: Traditional Simuna-Laekvere Run
The direction of the run changes every year
Venue: Simuna School
additional: The event takes place at Simuna School and is part of a series of running events in Lääne-Virumaa, offering a range of distances and age groups. Registration is online, and all participants have the opportunity to receive an award.

name: E-Lux Peetri Jooks
location: Peetri, Rae Parish, Harju County, Estonia
description: E-LUX Peetri Jooks is one of Estonia’s most vibrant mass-participation sports events, bringing together running enthusiasts of different ages and abilities. The main distance is 10 km, with timing and awards for the top finishers, but there is also a charity run, a youth run and children’s races. The event takes place in Peetri and, in addition to running, features a large expo and market area with various vendors and entertainment. The charity run supports the Tartu University Hospital Children’s Foundation and, through it, children with mobility impairments. All finishers receive a cool summer medal.
course_highlights: 10 km main race with timing and awards
5 km charity run and walk with timing and awards
Children’s races over 300 m and 1 km, with no timing
additional: The virtual run lets participants choose their own distance, time and location, and virtual runners receive a medal and prize-buffet products delivered to a parcel locker. Children’s races are untimed, with no rankings—all participants are winners. The event also features a large expo and market area with handicrafts, farm products, sweet treats, sports equipment and a children’s area. Volunteers are offered a hot meal and a goodie bag. The event includes an exhibition and community gathering, medals for finishers, and various categories for all age groups.

name: Simuna-Laekvere rahvajooks
description: The Simuna-Laekvere Fun Run is a traditional amateur race held every other year, alternating between Simuna and Laekvere. The course follows paved roads, with rolling sections and some climbs, offering participants a varied running experience. The event is friendly and well organized, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners, and offers a sauna and hot soup after the race. There are usually around 100 participants, creating a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere. Age categories are awarded, and the first ten finishers receive a race shirt.
course_highlights: The course follows paved roads
Rolling profile with some steeper climbs
A varied running experience in an area with little traffic
additional: Participants are offered a sauna and hot soup after the race. Awards go to the top three in each age category, and raffle prizes include a bicycle and other surprises. Bus transport between Laekvere and Simuna is provided before and after the race as needed. The outdoor course runs on asphalt and includes different age categories; registration details are not specified.

name: Võru kergejõustikuõhtu
location: Võru Staadion, Võru, Võru County, Estonia
description: The Võru Athletics Evenings series is a traditional series of athletics events combining track races, throws and jumps. Each evening includes one throwing event, one jumping event and running distances, offering a varied athletics experience. The competitions take place at Võru Stadium and use the IAAF scoring tables to determine the rankings. The series has five stages, one of which is the Võru County Championships. Participants must register separately for each stage, and their bib number is valid for the entire season.
course_highlights: A variety of athletics events at Võru Stadium
Each evening includes throwing, jumping and running events
The IAAF scoring tables are used to determine the rankings
additional: Registration opens on 28 May. Separate registration is required for each stage. The bib number is valid for the entire season, and participants are advised to leave it with the organizer at the end of each stage. Registration for throwing and jumping events usually closes at 16:30–16:45, and registration for races at 18:30–18:45. The competition schedule includes the exact registration and start times. The final stage of the series is on 3 August. Awards are presented at the end of the season. Competitions take place at several stages and include races, throws and jumps; registration is handled stage by stage. The event is part of the Võru sports calendar and welcomes all sports fans.

name: Aastajooks
description: Pärnu Year Runs is a running series that began in 1985, inspired by the Eastern zodiac calendar and dedicated each year to the animal symbol of that year. The theme of the 2026 series is the Year of the Fire Horse. It consists of nine stages held at three locations in Pärnu: Vallikäär, the beach, and the Reiu-Raeküla health trail. Three stages take place at each location, offering a varied and enjoyable running experience. The series is organised by the Pärnu Two Bridges Club, which invites all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy an active summer in Pärnu.
course_highlights: The series has 9 stages, held at three different start locations in Pärnu
Stages take place at Pärnu Vallikäär, Pärnu Beach, and the Reiu-Raeküla health trail
Three runs take place at each start location, offering a varied running experience
additional: The stages take place throughout the summer, starting at 18:00. Participants can purchase a season pass or register for individual stages. The organisers also offer the opportunity to volunteer. The series rules provide more detailed information about moving along the course, equipment, and safety. Participants can take part in different age and distance categories. Registration is open, and the event takes place at the beginning of summer each year.

name: Lääne-Virumaa noorte MV
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Youth Championships is an athletics competition for young people and adults held in Rakvere. The competition includes several athletics disciplines, such as running, jumping and throwing, and is intended for age groups from U-14 through to adults. Its aim is to honour the memory of Eerik Konist and promote athletics among young people. Medals are awarded in all age groups, and the top performers receive special prizes. The competition takes place at the stadium and starts at 11:00; registration opens at 10:00.
course_highlights: A range of athletics disciplines: running, jumping and throwing
Age groups from U-14 through to adults
The competition takes place at Heino Lipp Stadium in Rakvere
additional: Registration opens at 10:00, and technical event declarations must be submitted half an hour before the competition begins. In all events, competitors have four attempts in the jumps, shot put and throws. The top three in each age group are awarded, and the boy and girl with the best results receive special prizes. Registration begins at 10:00, and the competition starts at 11:00. Participants can enjoy sport and friendly competition, with medals and special prizes for the top performers.

name: 6. ETAPP - Nõmme terviserada
description: The Nõmme health trail is part of the Tradehouse Health Run and Walk series organised by Stamina Sports Club, which encourages people to stay active by collecting health kilometres. This stage offers the chance to enjoy the Nõmme area health trail, suitable for both runners and walkers. As part of the series, participants can collect health kilometres at both in-person and remote stages, as well as during individual training. The event is open to everyone who enjoys physical activity and wants to improve their health and spend time actively.
course_highlights: Nõmme health trail in Tallinn
Suitable for runners and walkers
Participation in the Tradehouse Health Run and Walk series
additional: The health kilometres programme runs from April to December, allowing participants to collect kilometres at series stages and during individual training. The list of registered participants is updated once every 24 hours. The series includes several stages in different locations and offers participants opportunities to improve their health. The event dates are 8 to 14 June 2026, and participation is available both in person and virtually.

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 3. etapp
location: Viljandi järve tervise- ja suusarada, Viljandi, Estonia
description: The 3rd stage of the Joosu Lake Run Series is a running event held on the health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi. The race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful views of the lake and varied terrain. The event is part of a series organised by the Joosu Health Sports Club, which promotes an active and healthy lifestyle. Everyone is welcome to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: Health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi
Beautiful lake views throughout the course
Varied terrain suitable for runners of different levels

name: Vanglateenistuse jooks
location: Jõhvi Muusikaväljak, Jõhvi, Ida-Viru County, Estonia
description: The Prison Service Run is part of the Ida-Viru Running Series and takes place at Jõhvi Music Square. This athletics event gives participants the chance to enjoy running in the beautiful surroundings of Ida-Viru County. The series includes several stages in different locations, offering a varied running experience. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and is traditionally well organized and friendly.
course_highlights: Venue: Jõhvi Music Square
Part of the 2026 Ida-Viru Running Series
An athletics event suitable for runners of different levels
additional: The run takes place over several distances, and registration is usually through Facebook or the official website.

name: ELVA SÜDAÖÖJOOKS 2026 TARTUMAA LIIGUB ETAPP
description: Elva Midnight Run 2026 is a night-time running and walking event held in Elva by the Cultural Centre. The races start in the evening and offer several distance options, including a 10 km run and walk, as well as children’s races. The event is part of Tartu County’s physical activity events and is suitable for both active runners and families. The organisers welcome everyone to take part and enjoy a sporty evening in Elva’s beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: 10 km run and walk around Elva Cultural Centre
Children’s races over 300 m and 600 m
Night-time event, with the running and walking races starting at 23:00
additional: The races begin with the children’s races at 21:00; the 10 km run and walk start at 23:00. It is also possible to take part in a virtual 10 km run. The organiser is Elva Sports Association, which brings together several local sports clubs. Virtual runs are also held as part of the event, and registration is open until race day. Participants have the opportunity to receive a medal and enjoy Elva’s beautiful natural surroundings and city atmosphere.

name: Eesti noorte KV
location: Tammiste staadion, Pärnu, Pärnu linn, Pärnu maakond, Estonia
description: The Estonian Youth Cup in archery takes place in Pärnu, giving young athletes the opportunity to compete and develop their skills. Several archery clubs from across Estonia take part, making it an important event in the young archers’ calendar. The competition is held at Tammiste Stadium, where athletes can demonstrate their accuracy and skill. This traditional event supports the development of young people in archery.
course_highlights: The competition takes place at Tammiste Stadium in Pärnu
Young athletes from several Estonian archery clubs take part
The competition includes different archery divisions
additional: A total of 88 young athletes from 8 archery clubs took part. Vana-Võidu VK / Viljandi SK had the largest contingent, and Türi Archery School won the most medals. Different archery divisions are represented, including recurve and compound. The competition features young athletes, with results including details of medalists and participants. The 2026 competition includes different events and has a substantial number of participants.

name: EKVA lahtised kergej. võistl.
description: The EKVA Open Athletics Competition takes place in Kohila and offers veterans and recreational athletes the opportunity to compete in various athletics events. It is intended for active athletes of all ages who want to test themselves and enjoy competing in athletics. EKVA regularly organizes various championships and series that help promote running and athletics in Estonia. The competition is open to both recreational athletes and veterans, with age-group categories.
course_highlights: The competition takes place at the stadium and in the surrounding area
A varied selection of athletics events: running, long jump, discus, shot put and javelin
Veteran age-group categories start at age 35
additional: The EKVA membership fee for 2026 is EUR 15 per year; honorary members and those over 77 are exempt from the fee. Please send competition results in PDF format to ennoakkel754@gmail.com. Veteran age-group categories start at age 35, and prizes are awarded to the top three women and men in each age group. The competition involves veterans and active athletes and offers opportunities to participate in the Estonian Championships and international competitions.

name: Viimsi maraton
description: Viimsi Marathon 2026 takes place on the Viimsi Peninsula and offers participants a course consisting of one large loop. The start and finish are in the parking lot of Randvere School. The varied terrain includes both paved roads and forest trails, with climbs and descents throughout the course. It’s a great opportunity to enjoy a summer run with a positive community.
course_highlights: One large loop on the Viimsi Peninsula
Varied terrain: paved roads and forest trails
Climbs and descents throughout the course
additional: The course includes climbs and descents, and participants are advised to bring enough drinks and food. Participants receive a commemorative medal at the finish.

name: Rapla Selveri suurjooks, virtuaaljooks
description: Rapla Selveri Suurjooks is a traditional running event held in Rapla, offering several distance options from children’s races to a half marathon. The event centre is located in the Rapla Selver car park, and the courses run along the town’s streets and highways. They are clearly marked and measured. Participants’ safety is ensured, and the race is organised by Kehakultuur OÜ in cooperation with Jooksja magazine. Pre-registration closes on 20 May, and start groups are formed according to expected finish times to ensure a smooth and safe race day.
course_highlights: The courses run along the streets and highways of Rapla
The 10 km course is certified, and the courses are marked
Cut-off times for the distances help ensure the race runs smoothly and safely
additional: The event centre opens at 9:00 in the Rapla Selver car park. The children’s races take place near Sadolin Sports Hall. Start groups are formed according to expected finish times to ensure safety and a smooth event. Nordic walkers and walkers are also welcome in the 5 km fun run. Participants must follow the instructions of traffic controllers and keep to the right side of the course so faster runners can pass on the left. Registration closes on 20 May. Various categories are available, as well as options for young participants and a virtual race.

name: Filter Temposari (3. etapp)
location: Vabaduse väljak, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia’s oldest and most prestigious time-trial series, offering the chance to test yourself in cycling, running or roller skating. The series takes place at various locations in Tallinn and its surroundings, featuring speed races with staggered starts. The Tallinn event takes place at Freedom Square, where the course is short and technical, making it well suited to sprint enthusiasts. The series’ finishers can take part in the Kullapada prize programme, which rewards consistent participation in every stage.
course_highlights: Staggered-start cycling races on a speed course around Tallinn
Short 1.3 km sprints in the heart of Tallinn at Freedom Square
Roller skating on roads with good surfaces
additional: The event has a fast group, whose riders are invited by name for the final 10 minutes. Warming up on the course during the competition is prohibited, but free warm-up rollers are available at the event centre. Participants must obey traffic laws, as most of the course is not closed to cars. The Kullapada prize programme rewards everyone who finishes all stages of the season. The event features varied terrain and offers registration and several distance options, including courses of 1.3 km and up to 5 km.

name: Kohila pikamaajooksude sari 2026 IV etapp 400m
location: Kohila Spordikeskuse staadion, Kohila, Rapla County, Estonia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Stardimaks 8 eurot, kuni 19a ja pensionärid 5 eurot

description: The Kohila Distance Running Series 2026, Stage IV, is a 400 m event held at the Kohila Sports Centre stadium and is open to everyone interested in running. The series offers various distances and age groups, with participants earning points according to their placing in each race. The entry fee is €8, or €5 for young people and pensioners, payable in cash on site. Pre-registration is recommended and closes at 16:30 on race day; those registering later will be placed in the later races. Series winners are determined by age group, and the awards ceremony takes place at the end of the series.
course_highlights: A 400 m race around the stadium
Races take place on the tartan track at the Kohila Sports Centre stadium
The series includes various age groups and distances from 400 m to 5,000 m
additional: Pre-registration closes at 16:30 on race day; those registering later will be placed in the later races. On-site registration closes at 18:30. Races start with the fastest heats. The top 10 finishers in each race earn points, and the best six races count toward the series standings. The awards ceremony takes place after the final event; participants must compete in at least four stages to qualify for a prize. The entry fee is payable in cash on site; pre-registration is available on the website; events take place at Kohila Stadium; age groups and points system.

name: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series is a sports series organised by Kohila Parish, consisting of several stages and aimed at sports enthusiasts in the area. Its goal is to promote sport and physical activity and give participants the opportunity to compete over various distances. Participants receive a commemorative medal at each stage, and points are awarded in competition classes across the series. The series is organised by Kohila Sports Centre, which supports a healthy lifestyle and active movement.
course_highlights: Multi-stage long-distance running series in Kohila Parish
Points awarded throughout the series and a commemorative medal for every stage finisher
Suitable for runners of different ability levels
additional: The series includes several stages over various distances, such as 800m, 2000m and 5000m. All participants receive a commemorative medal at every stage. Health checks are recommended before the competitions. Events are held mostly in the evenings, for example at 19:00. The series also includes 800-metre races, and participants can collect points throughout the season. The event is open to all age groups and offers opportunities to be active in a supportive community atmosphere.

name: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari
description: The KEVEK and Tartu Kalev Stadium Running Series is a track-and-field series organized by Tartu Kalev Sports Society, offering the opportunity to take part in several meets at stadiums in Tartu and Ülenurme. The series aims to provide competition opportunities for children and young people and promote participation in athletics in the city and county of Tartu. Meets take place during the summer months and are open to different age groups. Registration closes at 12:00 on race day, allowing for flexible participation.
course_highlights: Meets take place at Tartu Tamme and Ülenurme stadiums
The series includes several meets over the summer, including the June 6 and July 8 meets
Suitable for children and young people interested in athletics
additional: The 6th and 7th meets will take place at Ülenurme Stadium due to track resurfacing. Registration closes at 12:00 on race day. Madsa Sports and Recreation Centre is a supporter and offers a sports base in Valga County, 11 km from Otepää. The meets will take place on June 17, 2026, at Tartu Kalev Stadium. Registration is open, and participants can receive results and take part in various distances.

name: Rakvere lahtised MV
description: The Rakvere Open Championships are an athletics competition held at Rakvere Stadium. The event brings together the local sports community and offers the chance to watch competitions in a variety of athletics events. It is open to everyone and creates a sporty, supportive atmosphere.
course_highlights: The competitions take place at Rakvere Stadium
A variety of athletics events
A local sports community and supportive atmosphere
additional: The competitions are open to all participants, and registration takes place on site. The entry fee is 5 euros for participants living outside Lääne-Viru County.

name: Tallinna noorte MV
description: The Tallinn Youth Championships are an individual athletics competition for young people and adults, held in Tallinn. The competition includes several age groups, from U-14 to adults, and various athletics events such as running, jumping, shot put and throwing. Its aim is to honour the memory of Eerik Konist and promote athletics among young people. Medal awards are given in all age groups, and special prizes go to the top performers. The competition takes place at a stadium and starts at 11:00 in the morning; registration opens at 10:00.
course_highlights: A varied athletics programme: running, jumping, shot put and throwing
The competition takes place at Heino Lipp Stadium
Competitors are allowed 4 attempts in jumping, shot put and throwing events
additional: Registration opens at 10:00, and technical entries must be submitted half an hour before the competition begins. The top three in each event and age group are awarded medals, with additional special prizes for the best boys and girls. The chief judge is Viktor Predbannikov and the head secretary is Lilia Schmidt (tel. 5069887). The competition includes various events such as sprinting, long-distance running, high jump, pole vault, shot put, discus and javelin. Participants can experience competition and the joy of sport at a regional level.

name: Kuusalu valla kergej. MV
description: The Kuusalu Municipality Athletics Championships is a traditional athletics competition held in Kuusalu. Participants compete in various age groups and distances, offering opportunities for both recreational and more experienced athletes. The event is dedicated to the memory of Margus Keerma and is organized by the Treeningpartner sports club. The competition is a great opportunity to showcase your skills and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in Kuusalu Municipality.
course_highlights: A variety of athletics events
Competition for different age groups
A community sporting event
additional: The competition takes place at Kuusalu Stadium and includes various athletics events. Registration takes place before the competition begins.

name: Ümber Saadjärve jooks

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lastejooksudel osalemine on eelregistreerimisel kuni 18.06 TASUTA

description: The 38th Around Lake Saadjärv Run takes place on 20 June 2026 in Kukulinna, offering participants a 17 km run and a fitness walk around Lake Saadjärv. The course follows a paved road and has three drink stations to support runners during the event. In addition to the main run, the programme includes children’s races in different age groups and a fitness walk suitable for everyone who enjoys being active. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal, and the best participants are awarded prizes by age group. This traditional, well-organised event offers an enjoyable sporting experience for the whole family.
course_highlights: 17 km run around Lake Saadjärv on a paved road
Three drink stations at kilometres 5, 9 and 14
Start and finish by the Ice Age Centre
additional: The main run entry fee includes a race bib, timing service, course support, a drink at the finish, awards for the best participants and a participant medal. The fitness walk also has timing and a medal. On race day, payment is possible only in cash. Transfers to another participant are free until 17.06.2026 and cost 5 euros on race day. The shorter children’s race distances are not timed; the 9–10-year-old race is timed. The timing service partner is OÜ Teamtime, and results will be published at teamtime.ee/results. Registration is open until 18 June 2026. Participants are offered a medal, with awards in different age groups. The entry fee ranges from 15 to 20 EUR, and the children’s races are free.
