name: Võru kergejõustikuõhtu
location: Võru Staadion, Võru, Võru County, Estonia
description: The Võru Athletics Evenings series is a traditional series of athletics events combining throwing, jumping, and running disciplines. The series consists of several stages, where participants can compete in different distances and events, with the IAAF scoring tables used to determine rankings. Competitions take place at Võru Stadium and are open to athletes of varying abilities. The series offers a varied athletics experience for both recreational and advanced athletes.
course_highlights: Combines throwing, jumping, and running disciplines
Multi-stage series at Võru Stadium
Uses the IAAF scoring tables to determine rankings
additional: Registration usually opens in May. Separate registration is required for each stage. Registration for throwing and jumping events usually closes at 16:30, and for running events at 18:30. Participants receive a race number that is valid for the whole season. The competition schedule includes exact registration and event times; for example, registration for the long jump and discus throw closes at 16:45, and attempts begin at 17:00. Competitions take place at Võru Stadium. Information about the multiple stages, different athletics events, registration, and schedule is available.

name: Lüllemäe mägedejooks
description: The Lüllemäe Mountain Run is the third stage of the Valgamaa running series and takes place on the Lüllemäe health trails. The main race is 4.5 km, with tiny and mini races for children also held at the Lüllemäe Basic School stadium. The event is suitable for runners of different ages and offers the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting atmosphere. Children’s races are free, and the main race entry fees are reasonable, encouraging broad participation.
course_highlights: 4.5 km main race on the Lüllemäe health trails
Children’s tiny and mini races at the stadium, over distances from 100 m to 900 m
The event takes place in a beautiful natural setting in Valgamaa
additional: There is no entry fee for the children’s races. The NM18 age group in the main race is also free. Entry fees are paid in cash on site. For event information, call +372 5202962. Trail run on local terrain; registration at www.timesport.ee; free entry for children and the NM18 group.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 9. Rakvere valla Suvejooks
location: Kooli 4, Rakvere, Rakvere vald, Lääne-Virumaa, Estonia
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 is a multi-stage running and walking series featuring various races in the Lääne-Virumaa region. The 9th stage, Rakvere Municipality Summer Run, takes place on 18 July 2026 in Rakvere at Kooli 4. The series aims to offer running enthusiasts a sporting challenge and enjoyment, while promoting an active lifestyle throughout the region.
course_highlights: Varied terrain, including sports fields and cycle paths
Various distances and age categories
Large number of participants and community involvement
additional: Participants receive medals, and the results are officially published online; registration takes place through the website.

name: Väinjärve jooks , 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud VI etapp
description: The Järvamaa Lakes Runs is a traditional running series consisting of several stages held by different lakes in Järvamaa. The Väinjärv Run, taking place on 18 July 2026, is the sixth stage of the series. The race offers participants the chance to enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings and varied terrain around the lake. The series offers several distances and is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Runs take place by different lakes in Järvamaa
Varied terrain and beautiful natural surroundings
The sixth stage of a traditional running series, held by Väinjärv
additional: The races take place around Väinjärv and include several distances, including 400 m, 1.2 km and 4.6 km. Pre-registration is recommended to secure your participation.

name: Ümber Väinjärve jooks
description: The Run Around Lake Väinjärv is a traditional running event held around the beautiful Lake Väinjärv. It is part of the Väinjärv Water Festival sports programme, where sport and fun go hand in hand. Everyone is welcome to enjoy the natural surroundings of the lake and take on a sporting challenge. The Water Festival also features other sports and activities offering entertainment for participants of all ages.
course_highlights: Beautiful surroundings of Lake Väinjärv
Traditional running event around the lake
Suitable for all running enthusiasts
additional: The run is part of a wider sports programme that also includes swimming, a canoe rally, beach volleyball, a darts competition, beach football and children's sports competitions. The event is a traditional, entertaining occasion for athletes and families alike. Participants register on site. The event is part of a larger water festival and sports programme, featuring various sports and activities, and participation is free. Registration is already open for beach volleyball and beach football teams.

name: Rakvere valla suvejooks
description: The Rakvere Municipality Summer Run is a traditional running race held in the Sõmeru area. It is part of the Lääne-Virumaa Running and Walking Series and offers a sporting challenge for running enthusiasts. The courses are varied and suitable for runners of different levels. The race is friendly and community-oriented, welcoming all running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Varied terrain in the Sõmeru area
Suitable for runners of different levels
Part of the Lääne-Virumaa Running and Walking Series
additional: The race takes place at the Sõmeru-Näpi recreational sports field and is part of a local series of sporting events that brings together stages of the running and walking series.

name: 31. Jooks-kõnd ümber Uhtjärve
location: Uhtjärve Ürgoru Nõiariik OÜ, Uhtjärve, Võrumaa, Estonia
description: The 31st Run-Walk Around Lake Uhtjärv is a traditional running and walking series in the Võru County region, offering a variety of distance options for everyone. The event takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Lake Uhtjärv, providing a sporting challenge for both runners and walkers. The series includes various distances and mini distances suitable for beginners and experienced athletes alike. The event is part of the Võru County running and walking series, known for its friendly atmosphere and good organization.
course_highlights: Beautiful natural surroundings around Lake Uhtjärv
A variety of distances for runners and walkers
Suitable for beginners and experienced athletes alike
additional: The event center opens at 11:00 at the Kubija Ski Base. Buses depart from Kubija for Haanja and Kasaritsa, where the starts are located. In addition to the main distance, the series includes shorter distances, mini distances, and a walking option. A children's run is also held as part of the series. The event takes place on July 19, 2026, and includes running and walking around Lake Uhtjärv. Participants can choose from different distances and enjoy nature and sport.

name: Jooks ümber Uhtjärve
description: The Võrumaa Running and Walking Series is a multi-stage series of running and walking events offering a range of distances for both adults and children. The main distances are approximately 5 to 8 kilometres, and the course runs mainly on asphalt and gravel roads, with some off-road sections. The series also includes mini distances and toddler runs suitable for all age groups. The event is open to everyone interested in sport and promotes healthy lifestyles and community involvement.
course_highlights: The main distances run mainly on asphalt and gravel roads
The 8 km course around Lake Vaskna also includes softer ground on the grounds of the Haanja Recreation and Sports Centre
Mini distances and toddler runs take place on both asphalt and soft ground
additional: The series offers different distances: the main distance, a shorter distance, a mini distance and a toddler run. The course is mostly paved with asphalt, but also includes gravel and off-road sections. Walking options are also available on longer and shorter distances. Participants earn points in a season standings table, with separate rankings for families and groups of friends. Event centres and starts are held at different locations, such as Kubija Ski Base and the Haanja Suur Muna café. Bus transport to the start locations is arranged. There are multiple distances and stages; advance registration is required, and participation fees are listed in the registration form.

name: Aastajooks
organizer: Spordiklubi Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi MTÜ
description: Pärnu Annual Runs is a traditional running series that began in 1985 and is inspired by the Eastern calendar, dedicating each year to that year’s symbolic animal. The theme of the 2026 running series is the Year of the Fire Horse. It consists of nine stages held in three different areas of Pärnu: Vallikäär, Pärnu Beach, and the Reiu-Raeküla health trail. Three stages take place at each location, offering participants a varied and enjoyable running experience. The series aims to provide a sporting challenge and enjoyment for both recreational and experienced runners.
course_highlights: 9 stages divided among 3 starting locations: Pärnu Vallikäär, Pärnu Beach, and the Reiu-Raeküla health trail
3 stages at each starting location, for a total of 9 runs during the season
The running series theme is inspired by the Eastern calendar and dedicated to that year’s symbolic animal
additional: The series includes 9 stages divided among three different starting locations. Each stage starts at 18:00. Participants can purchase a season pass or register for individual stages. The organizers also welcome volunteers and offer gift cards. Several stages and different distances are available, including 1500 m at Vallikäär, 3000 m at the beach, and 5000 m at Reiu-Raeküla; the event takes place on 21 July 2026 in Pärnu.

name: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari
description: The Kohila Distance Running Series is a race series for sports enthusiasts in Kohila Parish, offering a variety of running opportunities for different age and ability groups. The series aims to promote recreational exercise and provide participants with an enjoyable sporting experience. Participants receive a commemorative medal at each stage, and points are tallied for the overall series standings. The series is organised by Kohila Sports Centre, which offers modern facilities and a strong sporting environment.
course_highlights: A range of running distances for different age groups
Points tally and commemorative medals at every stage
Organised at Kohila Sports Centre’s modern stadium and track
additional: All participants receive a commemorative medal at every stage. Points are tallied in each competition class for the overall series standings. Registration is available online at www.kohilaseeriajooksud.ee or by email and phone. Kohila Sports Centre offers a modern stadium and sports facilities, including a 400 m running track, spectator stands and a car park. The series consists of nine stages, during which participants collect points to determine the overall winners. Competitions take place at Kohila Stadium and are open to different age groups.

name: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari
description: The KEVEK and Tartu Kalev Stadium Running Series is a series of races organized by Tartu Sports Society Kalev and held in the city of Tartu. The series consists of several stages, offering opportunities to take part in track races across different age groups. Competitions are held mainly at Tamme and Ülenurme Stadiums and are aimed at both young people and adults, providing a friendly sporting environment. Registration closes at 12:00 on race day, offering flexibility for participants.
course_highlights: Competitions take place at Tartu Tamme and Ülenurme Stadiums
The series includes several summer stages, including stages 6 and 7 at Ülenurme Stadium due to track resurfacing
Suitable for different age groups and running distances
additional: Registration closes at 12:00 on race day. Stages 6 and 7 will take place at Ülenurme Stadium due to track resurfacing. Madsa Sports and Recreation Centre is a sports facility in Valga County supported by Tartu Sports Society Kalev, 11 km from Otepää, and is suitable for training camps and seminars. Race information includes registration, results, and upcoming dates. Participants can follow the results and view photos from previous events in the gallery.

name: Mispo maastikumaraton
location: Kurgja piirkond, Põhja-Pärnumaa vald, Pärnu maakond, Estonia
description: The Mispo Trail Marathon is a trail running event held in the Kurgja area of North Pärnumaa. Race distances are 42.195 km (marathon), 21.097 km (half marathon), 14 km and 7 km. The start is at the C.R. Jakobson Farm Museum at 11:00, and the race office opens at 9:00. All finishers receive a drink, food, access to a sauna, a diploma and a medal at the finish. The event is a tradition organized by Terviseklubi Mispo, an active sports club since 1989.
course_highlights: Trail routes in the Kurgja area
Start at the C.R. Jakobson Farm Museum
Distances: 7 km, 14 km, half marathon and marathon
additional: The race office opens at 9:00. Registration is available on race day, but the entry fee is €5 higher. All finishers receive a drink, food, access to a sauna, a diploma and a medal at the finish. The entry fee can be paid to Terviseklubi Mispo’s bank account. Trail terrain, race-day registration, medals, sauna and food.

name: Sakala metsajooks
location: Metsarada, Kurgja piirkond, Kurgja vald, Estonia
price_range: 20-35 € depending on registration date and distance
description: The Sakala Forest Run is a trail race held in the Metsarada area in Kurgja parish. The event offers several distances, including a marathon, half marathon, and shorter 7 km and 14 km races. The start is at 11:00 by the C.R. Jakobson Farm Museum. Participants are provided with a drink, food, sauna, diploma, and medal at the finish. This traditional event is organised by Terviseklubi Mispo and offers a sporting, friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Trail course in the Metsarada area
Start by the C.R. Jakobson Farm Museum in Kurgja
Distances: 7 km, 14 km, half marathon, and marathon
additional: The race office opens at 9:00. Registration on race day is available, but the entry fee is €5 higher. All finishers receive a drink, food, sauna, diploma, and medal at the finish. The entry fee can be paid to the Terviseklubi MISPO account at SEB, IBAN: EE931010902015384003.

name: KFC Südasuve Challenge - Pirita 2026
description: KFC Midsummer Challenge is a midsummer sports celebration taking place in Pirita for the third time. This community race offers beautiful views of the sea and Old Town, and a choice of three distances that participants can run or walk, or complete with a stroller or walking poles. The start and finish are conveniently located together on the shoreline, and the course follows the seaside pedestrian and cycling path without closing roads to traffic. All finishers will receive KFC gifts, and an event host and mascot will keep the spirits up.
course_highlights: Beautiful views of the sea and Old Town
Start and finish conveniently located together on the shoreline
The course follows the seaside pedestrian and cycling path without closing roads to traffic
additional: An interval-start system has been set up on the course to avoid bottlenecks. Participants can also complete the course with a stroller or walking poles. Challenges and prize draws for running enthusiasts will take place at the event and on social media. Multiple distances, a virtual participation option, a shoreline route, medals and prizes for finishers, a free concert, and themed food at KFC restaurants

name: Leigo Trail
description: Leigo Trail is a varied trail race in southern Estonia, held around the Leigo lakes. The race centre is at Leigo Tourism Farm, and the course offers a range of distance and difficulty options, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The routes follow forest trails, clay and gravel roads, and natural paths by the lake, featuring technical climbs and descents as well as beautiful views. The event brings together nature, exercise, and community, offering an enjoyable experience for the whole family.
course_highlights: An 18 km route on forest trails with steep climbs and descents; two laps of the 9 km loop
A winding 10 km clay-and-gravel route with moderate climbs; one lap
A scenic 4 km lakeside route; two laps of the 2 km loop, suitable for a first trail run
additional: The race centre is at Leigo Tourism Farm, with a race office, start and finish area, changing facilities and baggage storage, medical assistance, and catering. Free parking is available in a separate area; carpooling is recommended. Families and groups receive a 20% discount. Leigo Tourism Farm is open to visitors, and Open Farm Day takes place on the same weekend. To arrange accommodation, contact Leigo Tourism Farm. Family and group discounts are available as part of the event, and participants can choose from three distances. The course runs through natural surroundings, and registration includes various options. Parking and transport services are planned for race day.

name: Iigaste metsajooks
price_range: 4 euro (veteranid ja põhivõistlus), 8 euro kohapeal, tasuta lastejooksud ja NM18
description: The Iigaste Forest Run is part of the Rein Leppik Valgamaa Running and Nordic Walking Series, held every summer. This forest run gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting challenge on the 7.4 km main run, as well as shorter running and Nordic walking distances. The event takes place in Iigaste village and is suitable for different age groups, with medals and certificates awarded to the best finishers. Entry is affordable, and registration is conveniently available online.
course_highlights: 7.4 km main run on forest roads
3.7 km run and Nordic walking on the shorter distances
The event takes place amid the beautiful nature of Iigaste village
additional: Participation in the children’s races and the NM18 age group is free. The top three finishers in each age group receive a medal and certificate. Participants are responsible for their own health. Supporters are Eesti Kultuurkapital, Valgamaa Spordiliit, Mapco.ee and Iigaste village. The event takes place on a forest trail. Registration is through https://timesport.ee. Participants can choose from different distances, and the event is part of the Valgamaa Running and Nordic Walking Series.

name: 10. ETAPP
description: TV 10 Olympic Start is a competition series organized by the Estonian Athletics Association for schoolchildren and young athletes. Competitions are held in different age groups and include a variety of track and field events. The 10th stage takes place on 29 July 2026 at Tamme Stadium in Tartu, giving young people the opportunity to test their skills and gain experience. The series aims to support young people’s athletic development and provide a fun and motivating competitive environment.
course_highlights: Competitions take place at Tamme Stadium in Tartu
A variety of track and field events for different age groups
Open to schoolchildren and young athletes
additional: Registration takes place half an hour before the competitions begin. The top three in each event and age group are awarded medals, and the best performances receive special prizes. The competition is part of the TV 10 Olympic Start series and supports the development and competitiveness of young athletes.

name: Vormsi maraton
location: Sviby Harbour, Vormsi Island, Vormsi Parish, Lääne County, Estonia
description: Vormsi Marathons VIII is a two-day running event on Vormsi Island, taking place on July 31 and August 1 near Sviby Harbour. Participants can choose the marathon or half-marathon distance on either day, with the routes running mainly on paved roads on Vormsi Island. The routes are marked, and timing is recorded using electronic SI sticks. After the run, participants can enjoy a social get-together, a sauna and hot soup at the finish. The event is small and friendly, suited to both experienced runners and recreational runners.
course_highlights: The marathon route runs along Vormsi Island’s main paved roads
The half-marathon route passes through the villages of Hullo, Rälby, Diby and Norrby
The route follows hard-surfaced public roads, with turns marked
additional: The start and finish are on the square in front of the kiosk near Sviby Harbour. There is no course support; supplies can be replenished at the Hullo shop. The marathon is timed at one intermediate checkpoint and at the finish; the half-marathon is timed only at the finish. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal. After the run, participants can enjoy a social get-together and use the sauna. On Saturday, the finish closes at 16:45; on Friday, it stays open as long as needed. A purchased entry is valid for one or both days. It is not possible to complete both distances on the same day. Two-day run; no course support; camping or campground accommodation available; transport from Rohuküla.

name: 28. Holstre-Paistu maanteejooks Hanno Priksi mälestuseks
description: Holstre-Paistu Road Race is the fourth stage of Viljandi Municipality’s running series and takes place in Paistu. The race is intended for runners of all abilities and offers young people and adults alike the opportunity to take part. Participation in the series motivates runners to complete all four stages, and active participants are rewarded. The course runs through the scenic Viljandi County, offering an enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: Road race in the Paistu area
Participation opportunities in different age groups
Participants are motivated by awards in the running series

name: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane
location: Lähte terviserad, Lähte, Tartu County, Estonia

price_tiers.distance: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane Lähte 5 km

description: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane is an obstacle race held on the Lähte health trails. It is a varied and challenging run where participants climb, crawl, lift and drag themselves through mud, water, sand and hills. The event is suitable for both beginners and experienced obstacle racers, offering an exciting and fun experience. The series aims to offer a multi-day competition, with each stage having its own character and an emphasis on both fun and physical challenge.
course_highlights: 5 km course on the Lähte health trails
A variety of obstacles: climbing, crawling, lifting and dragging
Mud, water, sand and hills along the course
additional: A 15% discount applies when registering for at least three Vägilase jooks events at once. Payment via Stebby is possible. Discounts for young people under 20 and seniors aged 60 and over are applied automatically based on year of birth. Group discount of 20% for registering at least 4 people for the same event. The competition takes place over several days; each stage has its own character, with an emphasis on both fun and physical challenge. Participants take part at their own risk. Registration is open until 1 August. The entry fee includes a race number, medal, drink and snacks.

name: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Lähte
location: Lähte terviseradad ja jõulinnakus, Lähte, Estonia
description: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase Run Lähte is an obstacle race held on the Lähte health trails and at the strength-training park. The courses are 4 km and 8 km long and offer participants a serious challenge, with a variety of obstacles testing both strength and agility. Vägilase Run is Estonia’s most versatile obstacle-race series event, suitable for both beginners and experienced obstacle racers. The event is part of a series focused on terrain, obstacles and an adventurous experience.
course_highlights: 4 km and 8 km obstacle courses on the Lähte health trails and at the strength-training park
A variety of obstacles testing strength and agility
Mud, water, sand and hills along the course
additional: Children’s runs for participants up to 14 years old are free (when registered online before the event); on-site registration costs €3. All finishers in the children’s runs receive a medal and a treat. Participants are responsible for their own health; minors may participate with parental permission. There is no overall series ranking, but participants who take part in at least three stages receive a gift at the end of the season. Registering for at least three events at once gives a 15% discount. Vägilase Run shirts are available to purchase at a discounted price in December. Participants can register online, and the event has different categories and discounts. The course follows existing trails and roads, and the obstacles are built to be challenging and safe. Participation is at one’s own risk, and the event is open to all age groups.

name: Vääna-Jõesuu jooks
location: Vääna-Jõesuu Kooli staadion, Vääna-Jõesuu, Harku vald, Harju maakond, Estonia
description: The Vääna-Jõesuu Run is part of the Harku Municipality running series and takes place on August 2, 2026, at the Vääna-Jõesuu School stadium. The event offers several distances, from children’s races to the 5 km main race, which follows the streets of Vääna-Jõesuu and a forest road in a counterclockwise direction. The series aims to motivate people to take part in sports and promote the joy of movement and an active lifestyle. The event is organized by local running and triathlon clubs in cooperation with the municipality and village associations.
course_highlights: 5 km route along the streets of Vääna-Jõesuu and a forest road
The route runs counterclockwise
Children’s races on the stadium track (220 m and 660 m)
additional: The event center opens at 11:00, the main race starts at 12:00, the awards ceremony is at 13:00, and the children’s races start at 13:30. On-site registration and changes to registration are available until 15 minutes before the start. Awards are given to the top three men and women in each age group and the top three families in the family competition. The family competition is for mothers, fathers, and children, who earn points based on their age-group placements. More information about registration, event sponsors, and raffle prizes is available on the website. Participants are responsible for their own health, and the event is open to all age groups.

name: ÜLEMISTE Ööjooks - Tallinn 2026
description: ÜLEMISTE Night Run - Tallinn 2026 is a running and walking event taking place in the Ülemiste district of Tallinn. The event offers an opportunity to get active and support well-being and health. It is part of a wider initiative to promote recreational physical activity in Estonia, organised by the Centre of Competence for Recreational Physical Activity. Participants can enjoy being active in an urban environment and support their mental and physical health.
course_highlights: Running and walking in the Ülemiste district of Tallinn
A great opportunity to get active and support your health
Organised by the Centre of Competence for Recreational Physical Activity
additional: Participation involves running and walking; registration is open

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 20. Tapa linnajooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional running and walking series offering a variety of opportunities for different age groups and ability levels. Its events take place in different locations across Lääne-Virumaa, giving runners the chance to experience both urban and trail running. The 20th Tapa City Run takes place on 8 August 2026 at Tapa Gymnasium and is part of the series’ long-standing tradition of bringing together recreational athletes and running enthusiasts. The series aims to motivate people to stay active and provide enjoyable running experiences.
course_highlights: A varied route in an urban setting
Suitable for different age groups and ability levels
Part of a long-running series in Lääne-Virumaa
additional: The series offers different distances and age groups, including youth and children’s races. Events take place in different locations across Lääne-Virumaa, with both urban and trail runs. Registration is usually via online forms, but no direct registration link for the 20th Tapa City Run was found. The series contacts are Vahur Leemets and Ainar Sepnik. The event takes place at Tapa Gymnasium and offers online registration. Participants can choose from different distances, and awards are presented at every event.

name: Paldiski liigub
description: Paldiski Moves is the third stage of the Western Harju Movement Series and takes place at Paldiski Sports Centre. The course passes Paldiski’s main attractions, streets and pedestrian and cycling paths, offering participants beautiful natural views and a historic atmosphere. Free children’s races are held for younger family members, emphasising the joy of movement and lifelong awareness of physical activity. The event takes place as part of Paldiski City Day, where the series’ top finishers are awarded prizes, and the evening ends with a concert.
course_highlights: The course passes Paldiski’s main attractions
Runs along streets and pedestrian and cycling paths
Beautiful natural views and a historic atmosphere
additional: Chip timing is used, except for the untimed distance. The children’s races are free and intended for children aged 0–12. There are no placements; every finisher receives a diploma. The event is held in cooperation with Paldiski City Day, which offers activities for the whole family, and the series’ top three finishers are awarded prizes on the main stage. The evening ends with a concert. The children’s races are free, the course passes attractions, and chip timing is used (except for the untimed distance).

name: Kohila pikamaajooksude sari 2026 VI etapp 1000m
location: Kohila Spordikeskuse staadion, Kohila, Kohila vald, Estonia
description: Kohila Long-Distance Running Series 2026, Stage VI (1000 m), takes place at the Kohila Sports Centre stadium and is open to all running enthusiasts. The series features various distances and age groups, with participants earning points and winners determined by age group. The entry fee is €8, or €5 for young people and pensioners. Registration is primarily online in advance; on-site registration is available until 18:30. Series winners are awarded after the final race. To qualify for an award, participants must take part in at least four stages.
course_highlights: 400 m tartan running track at Kohila Stadium
Races over various distances, from 400 m to 5000 m
Age groups from young people to Veterans III (60+)
additional: Advance registration closes at 16:30 on race day. Late registrants are placed in the later heats, regardless of their expected time. On-site registration closes at 18:30. The top 10 in each race earn points; the total is calculated from each participant’s six best race results. Series winners are awarded after the final race. The entry fee is payable in cash on site. Advance registration is available at www.kohilaseeriajooksud.ee. Races take place at Kohila Stadium. Age categories and a points system are in place.

name: Filter Temposari (5. etapp)
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia’s oldest and most prestigious time-trial series, offering participants the chance to test themselves in cycling, running, or roller skating. The stages take place at various locations in Tallinn and the surrounding area, featuring individual time trials. The races are short and intense, suitable for both recreational and advanced athletes. The series also includes the Kullapada prize programme, which rewards consistent participation in every stage over the same distance.
course_highlights: Fast individual time-trial courses around Tallinn
Short 3–5 km runs and 7–17 km cycling courses
A new city sprint in the heart of Tallinn, featuring a 1.3 km course with a climb to Toompea
additional: Timing is accurate to a tenth of a second. Free warm-up trainers are available at the event centre. Hot Group: the final 10 minutes of each stage are reserved for the top cyclists. The courses are not closed to cars; competitors must obey traffic laws and keep to the right-hand side of the road. “I don’t have a time-trial bike” is no excuse—a standard road bike may be used. The event takes place at several different locations in Tallinn and includes time trials, sprint races, and special events such as the city sprint and series prizes.

name: 14. ETAPP / Järve terviserada
description: STAGE 14 / Järve health trail is a 10-stage relay race around Lake Viljandi, held on a health trail with varied terrain and different surface types. Teams consist of 10 members, with equal numbers of women and men, who take turns running the different stages. The start and finish are at Viljandi City Stadium, and organizers’ buses transport runners to the stages. The race is part of the tradition of the Great Run Around Lake Viljandi and offers a sporting experience for schools, companies, and sports clubs alike.
course_highlights: 10-stage relay race around Lake Viljandi on a health trail
Varied terrain and trails with different surfaces
Stages range in length from 500 m to 1,950 m
additional: Teams consist of 10 members (5 women and 5 men). Women run the odd-numbered stages and men run the even-numbered stages. Teams from institutions and companies may, as an exception, use a female runner on men’s stages. The entry fee is €50 for institutions, companies, and sports clubs; school teams pay no entry fee. Teams can register by email until 12 April, and runners must be registered by name at the stadium on 14 April. The awards ceremony takes place at 13:30 at the stadium. description: The 24th Run Around Võhma is a traditional 5 km running event held on the streets of Võhma and along its health trail. The course is mostly hard-surfaced, with arrows marking the route on the asphalt, and a cyclist rides ahead of the competitors. The event is open to everyone born in 2020 or earlier and is suitable for both runners and walkers, including Nordic walkers, who start from the last row. Electronic timing is provided, and every finisher receives a medal. The event takes place at Võhma School stadium, which is also the start and finish venue.
course_highlights: 5 km course on the streets of Võhma and along its health trail
Mostly hard-surfaced, with arrows marking the route on the asphalt
A cyclist rides ahead of the competitors; the course is open to traffic
additional: Registration is available online until 24 September at timesport.ee, and on race day in front of Võhma School from 10:00 to 11:40. Timing is electronic, using a chip attached around the ankle, which must be returned at the finish. There is a €70 penalty for a chip that is not returned or is lost. Medals are distributed to participants, and prizes are raffled. Competitors are responsible for their own health. Children may take part at their parent’s responsibility. Registration is available both online and on site, and participants receive prizes and medals. The course runs along city streets and asphalt, offering a pleasant and motivating running experience. The event takes place on 26 September 2026.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 41. Jooks ümber Porkuni järve
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional running and walking series offering a variety of distances for different age groups and ability levels. Its events take place in beautiful locations across Lääne-Virumaa, giving runners both the excitement of competition and an enjoyable sporting experience. The main races, as well as youth and children’s races, are popular throughout the series and encourage physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The series’ events have earned a firm place in runners’ calendars and hearts.
course_highlights: A variety of distances, from children’s races to the main races
Courses pass through scenic natural locations in Lääne-Virumaa
The series features a mix of running formats and traditional events
additional: The series includes separate races for children and young people. These are not official competitive distances, but they offer a valuable running experience. Events take place at different locations in Lääne-Virumaa, for example by Kadrina Reservoir, at the Simuna-Laekvere Run, and at the Kunda City Run. Participation has been high, with more than 200 athletes at the Kunda run, for example. The series also includes recreational walks and a range of age groups. Events feature different race distances and formats, including the main race, mini run, toddler run, children’s race, and youth race, and also offer the opportunity to take part in walking events.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Metsajooks 2026
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Forest Run is a trail race taking place on 27 September 2026, offering participants the chance to run along beautiful trails through a pristine nature reserve. The race features distances of 21 km, 10 km and 5 km, as well as a youth run for participants up to 17 years old and free children’s runs. The routes run entirely through the nature reserve, offering breathtaking views and fresh air. The race centre is conveniently located near Tallinn, and the whole family can enjoy additional activities, childcare, a sauna and hot tubs. All finishers receive a medal and gifts; prizes are awarded to the winners, and the season’s best performers and teams are recognised.
course_highlights: The entire route runs through a stunning nature reserve
A trail run in pristine nature, with a mix of climbs and descents
Routes suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike
additional: The race centre opens at 10:00, children’s runs start at 10:40, and the group warm-up is at 11:45. After the run, free soup and a smoothie will be served, and the sauna and hot tubs will be open. A Sportland pop-up shop will be at the race centre. Prizes for the winners; the season’s best performers and teams will be recognised. Option to rent a private Iglusauna on the shore of the pond. Childcare and activities for the youngest family members. Finish closes at 15:30. Trail running, forest trails, family and children’s runs, registration and information HERE, a modern race experience and family events

name: 16. ETAPP
description: The 16th stage is part of a recreational running series held in Tallinn. The event centre, start and finish are at Järve Health Trail, offering participants an enjoyable running and Nordic walking experience at the car park by the shared-use path. The route is easily accessible by car and public transport, making it convenient to take part. The series aims to offer everyone an opportunity to spend their free time in an active and healthy way.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking on Järve Health Trail
Start and finish at the car park by the Järve shared-use path
Easy access by car and public transport
additional: The event centre, start and finish are at the car park by the Järve shared-use path, at the Viljandi mnt end of Järve Health Trail. Those arriving by car are advised to park at Järve Selver, from where it is about a 400 m walk or jog to the event centre. Those travelling by bus should get off at the Risti stop, from where it is about a 300 m walk to the event centre.

name: Friday Night Run 2026
description: Friday Night Run is an energetic night run in central Tartu, taking place on 2 October at Town Hall Square. The distance is approximately 4 km, along city streets, offering a chance to enjoy the atmosphere of the autumn city with friends. This is not a race; participants can choose to run with or without timing. The event features music and a live concert, creating a lively evening atmosphere.
course_highlights: An approximately 4 km course in central Tartu
The course runs along city streets and park paths
One split-timing point on the timed distance
additional: The race number must be pinned to the chest and visible throughout the distance. The timing chip is attached to the back of the race number and is for single use. Participants have 45 minutes to complete the course; the finish closes at 21:45. The entry fee includes a marked course, race number, timing (if using a chip), services at the finish, and medical assistance if needed. Registration is available online until 2 October at 17:00 and on site until 20:30. The event includes online and on-site registration, medals and T-shirts for participants, and group discounts.

name: 15. Tartu Linnamaratoni Lastejooksud
description: The Tartu City Marathon children’s runs are open to all children, with the joy of taking part as the main goal. Recommended guidelines are provided for distances and age groups, but every child is welcome on the course and treated equally. Race numbers are handed out one hour before the start, and participants are not ranked. The event takes place at Tartu Town Hall Square, and children can register in advance or on site.
course_highlights: The children’s runs take place at Tartu Town Hall Square
All children are welcome, regardless of age or previous experience
All children receive the same race number (number 1), and the starting procedure is simple
additional: Those who register in advance will receive a unique QR code to collect their race number. Race-number distribution begins one hour before the start, near the Tartu Market Hall. All children start with race number 1. Participants can download and colour in a personalised diploma. Participants’ names will be published on the website after the event. Prizes will be drawn among all those who registered in advance. Several partners offer discounts to participants. Medals and diplomas are provided to all participants. Registration is available online and on site, and the entry fee is 4 euros.

name: /M.Pirksaare/Türi Tehisjärve jooks, liikumissari 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud 11. etapp
description: The Türi Artificial Lake Run is part of the 8th Järvamaa Lakes Run Series, which offers varied running opportunities for different age groups. The course goes around Rava Artificial Lake, with varied surfaces of sand, soil and gravel. The best runners are awarded prizes, and the event is suitable for both recreational runners and young running enthusiasts. The event takes place on October 7, 2026, by Lake Rava in Järvamaa.
course_highlights: Running course around Rava Artificial Lake
Varied surfaces: sand, soil and gravel
Several lake views along the course
additional: Runners are counted in different age groups in the Järvamaa Lakes Run Series. There are separate starting lanes on the course, and the runs are suitable for everyone from toddlers to adults. The best men and women who complete one lap of the lake in the fastest time are awarded prizes. The race is part of the Järvamaa Lakes Run Series, which includes several stages and supports community wellbeing and recreational sport.

name: 42. Munamäe–Võru maastikujooks-kõnd
location: SA Võru Spordikeskuse suusabaas Kubijal, Võru, Estonia
description: The 42nd Munamäe–Võru Cross-Country Run and Walk is part of the Võrumaa running and walking series, offering a variety of distances for both runners and walkers. The main distance follows trails and asphalt roads, offering a varied route in the Võru area. The series also includes shorter distances and runs for toddlers, suitable for participants of all ages. The event takes place at the Kubija Ski Base of the Võru Sports Centre Foundation (SA Võru Spordikeskus), known for its beautiful nature and good trail conditions.
course_highlights: The main distance follows trails and asphalt roads in the Võru area
A variety of distances: approx. 5.9 km, a 1.16 km mini-distance, and runs for toddlers
The route is partly off-road and partly asphalt-paved
additional: The event centre opens at 11:00 at Kubija Ski Base. Buses depart from Kubija for various start locations, including Haanja and Kasaritsa. In addition to running, the series includes walking and runs for toddlers. The route follows asphalt and gravel roads in part and also includes softer terrain within the grounds of the Haanja Recreation and Sports Centre. Shorter distances for children and beginners are also held as part of the event. Registration and maps are available on the organiser’s website. The event supports healthy lifestyles and active community participation.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 7. Võsu Sügisjooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional running and walking series offering a variety of opportunities for different age groups and ability levels. Its events take place across Lääne-Virumaa, giving runners beautiful scenery and an enjoyable sporting experience. Võsu Autumn Run is the series’ 7th event. It takes place in the Võsu Laine area and is part of a long-running series. The series aims to motivate people to stay active and enjoy running and recreational sport.
course_highlights: Varied terrain in the Lääne-Virumaa region
Part of a long-running series
Courses suitable for different age groups and ability levels
additional: The series offers different distances and age groups, including youth and children’s races. Events take place at various locations in Lääne-Virumaa, and the route direction and terrain may vary from year to year. Participants are encouraged to register in good time, but specific registration and pricing details are not available. Other races and activities also take place as part of the Võsu Autumn Run. Registration is online, and participants may receive awards by age group.

name: 71. Viljandi Linnajooks
description: The Viljandi City Run is a traditional distance race held every year on the second Sunday of October in the city of Viljandi. The race follows a route around Lake Viljandi and is one of Estonia’s oldest sporting events, attracting top runners from across the country. In addition to the main race, several mass-participation events take place, including children’s races for different age groups. The Viljandi City Run course is 10.4 km long, offering an athletic and lively experience for both recreational and professional runners.
course_highlights: Race around Lake Viljandi
Course length: 10.4 km
One of Estonia’s oldest distance-running traditions
additional: Children’s races for ages 5–6, 7–8, 9–10 and 11–12, free of charge and without timing. The 5 km fun run starts at 11:00. The award ceremony takes place at 14:00. Registration and race-pack collection at Vabaduse Square from 9:00 to 11:30. The race route closes at 14:30. Race day begins with registration at Vabaduse Square at 9:00, and events run until 14:30. Participants receive medals, and children’s races and a recreational run are also held as part of the event.

name: Sõeru Kevadjooks
description: The Sõeru Spring Run is dedicated to the historic Sõeru spring, located on the Vanamõisa multifunctional health and learning trail. The event aims to promote recreational running, provide an opportunity to compete, and determine the winners in different distances. It is also important to introduce the area, offer the whole family an opportunity to spend active leisure time outdoors, and promote a sporting lifestyle.
additional:
Registration and race starts take place at the Vanamõisa Outdoor Centre (Vabaõhukeskuse tee 20), Vanamõisa village, Saue municipality, Harju County. Race packs will be distributed on 12 May from 17:00 to 20:00 at the café in Vanamõisa Caravan Park (Vabaõhukeskuse tee 18). On 13 May, race pack distribution and competitor registration begin at 15:00 in the log hall at the Vanamõisa Outdoor Centre. Race numbers will be distributed until 17:15, and until 16:30 for the children’s runs.

The children’s runs start at 17:00
The main race starts at 18:00
The youth race starts at 18:10
All races start at the Vanamõisa Outdoor Centre. The finish is at the same location.

name: Kopli Liinide Jooks
description:
The course starts from the Kopli Lines promenade. The route continues through Kopli Käsepark, then along the seashore.

The first half of the route follows the seashore, offering beautiful views of Kopli Bay.

The route also passes through the Paljassaare Conservation Area, a beautiful nature reserve known for birdwatching. We then continue through the Tallinn Water property, where you can see how water is treated, before returning to the promenade.
